theorem norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem {α y n w G : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 < y) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n y)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y) (hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n)
    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) :=

note: Lean proves monotonicity of g on the whole range up to z^{1/3}/6 and uses no K, so the book's range gaps between (y/K)^{1/3}/6 and y^{1/3}/6 do not arise. Erratum: Case 2 runs up to q = y^{1/3}/6 = 3.59·10⁷ (y = 10²⁵), but (11.18) holds only for q ≤ (y/K)^{1/3}/6 = 1.17·10⁷, and the C_{φ,0,K} term is omitted as in (13.14) (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_13_15.py`).
